description: qou-cds1 Step 23: Delta_L's ellipticity is STRUCTURAL, not an artefact of the 11-crossing word choice. The mechanism is the traceless-2x2 identity det(A_0-B_0) = det A_0 + det B_0 + tr(A_0 B_0): both nucleon traceless parts are HYPERBOLIC (det -1.041656, -1.056560) and their Killing pairing 2.107175 exceeds the exact-parallel threshold 2*sqrt(dA dB) = 2.098163 by 0.43 %, so the difference is elliptic BECAUSE the neutron and proton are nearly the same sl_2 direction -- the near-degeneracy of the nucleons, not a word. Supported by: 8/9 quark-word orderings elliptic (caveat: only 3 distinct values, so the count overstates it); a random control at matched scale giving 8.9 % (4000 draws), an order of magnitude below; and no sign change in the discriminant across q in [1.01,1.61], so no fine-tuning at q_0. Does NOT make it the right generator: the eigenphase stays a factor 35.7 from the ladder phase. Lean: QOU/QBeta/TracelessDifferenceEllipticity.lean, sorry-free.

assertions.name: mechanism_identity_holds
assertions.detail: det(A_0 - B_0) = det A_0 + det B_0 + tr(A_0 B_0): 0.00895914342752 vs 0.00895914342752 (Lean det_sub_traceless)

assertions.name: both_nucleon_directions_are_hyperbolic
assertions.detail: det A_0 = -1.041655651, det B_0 = -1.056560371 — so the elliptic difference requires genuine ALIGNMENT, it is not free

assertions.name: nucleons_are_nearly_parallel_in_sl2
assertions.detail: tr(A_0 B_0) = 2.107175165 against the exact-parallel 2.098163083 — aligned to 0.42952 %. This is the near-degeneracy of the nucleons

assertions.name: enriched_over_its_own_random_null
assertions.detail: resampled NF differences are elliptic 8.925 % of the time (357/4000); the nucleon orderings give 8/9

assertions.name: counting_evidence_is_weaker_than_it_looks
assertions.detail: the 9 orderings collapse to 3 distinct (tr,det) pairs, so 8/9 overstates it — stated because it would be easy to quote the 8/9 alone

assertions.name: elliptic_across_the_whole_q_range_no_fine_tuning
assertions.detail: discriminant negative at all 31 samples over q in [1.01,1.61], 0 sign changes, smooth from -0.0337627 to -0.044844

context.axis: qou-cds1: is Delta_L's ellipticity structural or a word artefact?
context.answer: Structural. The difference of two hyperbolic sl_2 directions is elliptic exactly when they are aligned past 2*sqrt(dA dB), and the nucleons clear that by 0.43 % -- which IS their near-degeneracy. Robust in q, enriched 10x over its own random null.
context.not_claimed: that det rho(NF(p)) = det rho(NF(n)) exactly (they agree to 1.4e-16 relative and both words have 11 crossings, but it is not proved and not used); and NOT that Delta_L is the right generator -- the eigenphase remains a factor 35.7 from the ladder phase.
context.scope: Scope-(a). Nothing derived, proposed, wired or readmitted.
